acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every commissioned resident has a Visual Bible manifest and linked image-library controls.
Canonical hero/profile/full-body/360 requirements are represented as governed manifest slots or restricted indexes.
Measurement/proportion decisions are recorded with no raster promotion beyond manifest-control readiness.
Avatar/icon recognizability controls exist for supported interface sizes.
Group-scene identity, relative height, posture, and role-presence controls exist.
Caption-hidden recognition is recorded as a manifest-control validation gate.
Prompt and negative-prompt/provenance controls are captured where generation is permitted.
Rejected/deferred variants remain archival/provenance records rather than silent replacements.
Evelyn private-mode hooks are separately indexed and restricted.
The final canonical-lock report distinguishes approved, restricted, provisional, and deferred scope.

notes: Validation is scoped to repository manifests, prompt contracts, provenance records, and governed asset slots.
No placeholder raster is promoted beyond its existing classification.
